title: Zenith Hackathon 2027
objectives: Create networking opportunities with industry and alumni
resources: Lab access, projectors, certificates and volunteer coordination

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 86 attendees for this Hackathon, in line with turnout at our previous Hackathon events.
The requested budget of INR 41,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Hackathon.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
